purpose: Hard pre-evolution baseline. Every later milestone compares itself against these exact observed results. Regenerating this file is forbidden; later baselines must be new files.
compatibility_contract: GraphMode.REAL / SPATIAL_SURROGATE / SYNTHETIC_TEST separation must remain.
111 tests must keep passing (may only grow).
32 acceptance gates must keep passing or become explicit SKIP with reason.
CPU reference LIF behavior must remain the correctness baseline.
Existing CLI commands, UI routes, and checkpoint formats must remain readable.
LLM failure semantics: unavailable model must never produce text.
